name: Spectrum SBS560CHT 40V Cordless Hedge Trimmer Kit 45cm Laser-Cut Blade with 2.0Ah Battery and Charger
Body Copy: Shape and tidy established hedges with a 45cm cordless trimmer that runs on the same 40V battery as the rest of the Spectrum cordless garden range. This complete kit ships with the SBS560CHT trimmer, a 40V 2.0Ah lithium-ion battery and a matching charger, so the tool is ready to use straight from the box. An 18mm cutting capacity takes the woody growth that softer-stalk shrubs don't, while the brushless motor sustains 2,600 cuts per minute for a clean, even finish. The laser-cut blade holds that finish across longer sessions, and a 90 degree rotating rear handle switches from horizontal top cuts to vertical face cuts without changing your stance. At 2.91kg the tool body is light enough to hold overhead for extended cuts, and the included 2.0Ah pack drops straight into the rest of your Spectrum 40V cordless tools. Backed by a five-year domestic warranty as standard.
Unique Selling Point 01: Cuts up to 18mm woody growth without stalling or snagging
Unique Selling Point 02: Brushless motor sustains 2,600 cuts per minute for clean results
Unique Selling Point 03: 45cm laser-cut blade keeps the finish consistent across long hedges
Unique Selling Point 04: 90 degree rotating rear handle for top and face cuts
Unique Selling Point 05: Shares 40V batteries with the full Spectrum cordless range
Unique Selling Point 06: Kit ships with 2.0Ah lithium-ion battery and matching charger
Unique Selling Point 07: Light 2.91kg tool body for comfortable overhead trimming
Unique Selling Point 08: Backed by a five-year domestic warranty as standard
